lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to generate random quiz questions, keep score in a variable, and add a time limit with the timer.
Store two random numbers in variables, then ask about them.
Every time the quiz runs, the questions are different.
Set score to 0 at the start.
Each correct answer: change score by 1.
At the end, say the score.
Put the question code inside repeat (5) to ask five different questions.
Reset the timer at the start.
“wait until timer > 10” lets you end the game after 10 seconds.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
